name: Tracing the Source
label: Quest
description: Tracing the Source: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Something funny about the cologne? It's possible. I've never seen so many people after one product like this.
Look, if there's something wrong with it, I want to know, too. I bought my supply from a merchant named Evert Sorisam. He's new in town.
He mentioned he had some goods he was going to deliver to The Finest Thread.
